rulings.why: Real player-side resource (temp HP = level after rest, cap 2x level) and no lane carries it: Feat has no temp-HP field, CLASS_RESOURCES is class-keyed with a 'feat' parity hook only, and Rage's temp HP ships as mode PROSE — so needsEngineWork is the honest flag.

Changes the character's own crit threshold on a roll they make; the registry already carries degree-of-success entries of this exact shape (fire-savvy 'a success becomes a critical success'), and the id is in no registry.
A damage rider the PLAYER deals, conditional on the crit and the damage type; artery-map is the registered twin (1d6 persistent bleed as a strikeDamage situational) and this id has no entry.
A flat check the player rolls; cindersoul/fire-lung/fire-savvy carry exactly this hp-target shape in FEAT_SITUATIONAL and scar-thick-skin has no entry.

Mode lane is real (core.modes already ships feat-gated werecreature shape modes dire-form/force-of-nature) but the judge's plain 'slashing' over-grants against silver weapons; the corpus embeds exceptions in the type string (only-my-doom-may-claim-me).

mode.name: Scarred Hide (hybrid or animal shape)
mode.duration: while in your hybrid or animal shape
mode.note: Werecreature: while in your hybrid or animal shape you have resistance to non-silver slashing damage equal to half your level.

rulings.why: Both halves are player-side and unmodelled: the persistent-fire flat check matches the registered fire-lung shape, and 123 passive feats already carry limitedUses for exactly this kind of once-per-day protection.
The bonus lands on the player's own initiative roll, and unwavering-guide is the registered precedent ('on initiative rolls when you Scouted', +2 circumstance); scout-dedication has no entry.

needsEngineWork stands after checking the daily-choice lane: from.type 'own-spell' reads cantrips+repertoire only and never a wizard's spellbook, and the scroll count (2/3/4 by spell-DC rank) and rank ceiling (highest rank -2) cannot be expressed by a fixed picks/maxRank.

MISS is right but the lane EXISTS: a daily-preparation open spell pick (westyrs-wayfinder-repository is the daily twin, magical-adept the two-picks/rank-window twin), so this is data, not engine work.

choice.prompt: Today's temporary scroll(s) — a 1st-rank spell, plus a 2nd-rank spell from 8th level
choice.inert: Recorded only — the temporary scrolls aren't added to your inventory.
choice.note: Choose a 1st-rank spell of any tradition; from 8th level also choose a 2nd-rank spell (below 8th, fill only the first). The spell must be common or one you have access to; the list enforces neither that nor which pick is which rank. The scrolls lose their magic at your next daily preparations and can't be used to Learn a Spell.

rulings.why: removesWeaknesses is the field whose whole purpose is this, with beastkin-resilience as the live precedent (werecreature-dedication really does carry weaknesses silver); the poppet ancestry's missing flammable weakness is a separate ancestry-data gap, not a reason to leave the feat blank.

Confirmed no lane: base ikons are the exemplar CLASS extraChoices group (core.ikon, 21 options, pickByLevel), the 27 ikon-TRAIT feats are imbued ikons, and no feat-level field raises an extra-choice pick count for an archetype character.
Changes the flat check the player rolls to target; superior-sight/firesight/fire-lung carry exactly this strikeAttack targeting shape and this id appears in no registry.

Player-side detection state and a DC-5-instead-of-11 flat check the player rolls; nothing in core.json or the registries carries it, and perception is a legal target kind for the 'notice or target' wording.

Mode lane is right but the flat fly 20 under-grants — SpeedGrants accepts a formula string and deriveSpeeds resolves @actor.speed.land with max(), which is how 'equal to your land Speed or 20, whichever is higher' is actually written.

mode.name: Sentinel's Orbit (sentinel form)
mode.note: Starlit Sentinel: while in your sentinel form you have a fly Speed equal to your land Speed, or 20 feet if that is higher.

rulings.why: All seven spells ship in core.json, but grantedSpells exists only on SubclassOption and no feat-level field widens a caster's legal spell list, so the pickers still filter this character strictly by tradition.

The spells land on the summoner, not the eidolon, and there is nothing to project from: magical-understudy carries no field at all, and magical-adept/master store their picks as choice ANSWERS that no lane can read into an innate entry.

Upheld despite the judge's wrong premise (shield-bash/boss/spikes ARE real weapon items, group 'shield'): the only die-step mechanisms are unarmedTraits.stepDie (unarmed only) and a hardcoded Deadly Simplicity, so no field can step a wielded weapon's die.

The pick should be recorded (terrain-stalker, a purely table-side Sneak permission, carries exactly this), but the lane is FeatChoiceDef `choice` — effectChoices is for options that contribute a concrete grant and stores under a different key.

choice.note: In the chosen terrain you can Hide and Sneak even without cover or being concealed — applied at the table.

rulings.why: The land-Speed change is real (merfolk base 5 to 25) but mode speeds.land is ADDITIVE in deriveSpeeds, so a flat 25 would produce 30; a formula pins the total at exactly 25 and survives the Cecaelia heritage's 10-foot floor.

mode.name: Shore Gift
mode.duration: indefinite (use the action again to revert)
mode.note: You walk on two legs: your land Speed becomes 25 feet. You lose the swim Speed from your merfolk ancestry (swim Speeds from other sources remain). Using the Shore Gift also counts as creating a disguise for Impersonate and automatically defeats Perception DCs to notice it.
